hero.eyebrow: Independent land search · Los Lagos & Patagonia
hero.title: Find your place in Patagonia.
hero.lead: Patagonia Land Hunter is LAND ADVISORS' active search service: we define where and what to look for, shortlist opportunities with territorial criteria, and support you through the purchase decision — with no own inventory to sell.
hero.ctaPrimary: Tell us what you're looking for
what.label: Patagonia Land Hunter
what.title: We don't sell land. We find it for you.
what.lead: We work exclusively on the buyer's side. We are not a brokerage or listing portal: we have no own plots to push.
what.body: Many buyers — in Chile and abroad — arrive with a clear goal but without knowing which zone to focus on, which questions to ask, or how to compare options with criteria. This service structures that path.
includes.label: What may be included
includes.title: A concrete search, with clear deliverables
includes.lead: Each mandate adapts to your objective. These are the typical components of Patagonia Land Hunter:
includes.item1: Strategic brief: objective, budget, size, access, connectivity, land use and project horizon
includes.item2: Search zone definition in Los Lagos and/or Patagonia — with criteria to rule out mismatched areas
includes.item3: Active search across public market, local networks and off-market contacts
includes.item4: Curated shortlist: few compatible alternatives, not mass listings
includes.item5: Preliminary territorial review: access, surroundings, connectivity, apparent risks and key questions before offering
includes.item6: Coordination of site visits and joint tours when appropriate
includes.item7: Support comparing alternatives and preparing negotiation
includes.item8: Coordination with lawyers, brokers and technical professionals — without replacing their reports
includes.disclaimer: LAND ADVISORS does not replace legal advice, title review, topographic, environmental or engineering studies. When needed, we guide you to hire those services before closing.
includes.risk.title: Reducing legal and practical risk
includes.risk.body: Buying land in Chile involves zoning, subdivision rules, services, access and documentation that vary by municipality and region. Our role is to help you move forward in order: what to review, when, and with whom — before committing capital.
why.label: Territory
why.title: Two regions, different types of opportunity
why.lead: We focus this service on Los Lagos and Chilean Patagonia — where we combine local presence, field work and contact networks.
why.note: There is no single "best zone". There is a zone that fits your objective, budget and how you plan to use the land.
zone.lagos.title: Los Lagos Region
zone.lagos.text: Lago Llanquihue basin, Puerto Varas, Frutillar, Llanquihue and rural contour: nature, services, air connectivity from Santiago and quality of life. Ideal if you want balance between landscape and access.
zone.lagos.bullet2: Services, connectivity and urban life nearby
zone.lagos.bullet3: Second home, family project or patrimonial investment
zone.patagonia.title: Patagonia
zone.patagonia.text: From northern Patagonia to more remote territories: large-scale landscapes, privacy, lifestyle projects, conservation or tourism development with a long-term horizon.
process.label: How we support you
process.title: Six things you should not handle alone from abroad
process.lead: Buying land in Chile from overseas involves steps many buyers prefer to delegate — always with local criteria and transparency.
step1.title: Suitable properties
step1.text: We identify options that fit your brief through partner brokers and trusted local contacts — not a mass listing dump.
step2.title: Regional guidance
step2.text: We help you understand which areas make sense for your objective, budget and how you plan to use the land.
step3.title: Legal verification
step3.text: We coordinate what to review and with whom — titles, easements and documentation — before you commit capital.
step4.title: Zoning and subdivisions
step4.text: Preliminary check of local rules: what can be built, how the plot is divided and early warning signs.
step5.title: Negotiation support
step5.text: We compare alternatives, prepare your position and support you in negotiation with market and territorial context.
step6.title: Lawyers and notaries
step6.text: Coordination with Chilean professionals through closing. We do not replace their advice — we help you move forward in order.

intl.lead: Buying land in Chile from abroad requires local presence, regional criteria and the ability to visit and filter opportunities before you travel.

intl.partners.text: We collaborate with real estate advisors and firms that already have a client interested in Chile — acting as Local Land Acquisition Partner while you keep the client relationship.
